app.name: Craft: Notes, Documents, AI
app.description: An all-in-one space for writing, collaborating, and getting organized with notes, documents, and AI assistance.

verdict.one_liner: Craft makes strong privacy promises: no ads, no data selling, and users keep control over their content.
verdict.summary: Craft explicitly states it does not sell your data or use it for advertising. The app collects standard account information, usage data, and analytics through third-party providers for service improvement. Users can request data deletion and disconnect third-party integrations at any time. The main concerns are standard sharing with service providers and vague policy change notifications.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Craft has strong privacy practices with explicit commitments against advertising and data selling, plus good user controls for data deletion and third-party integrations.

red.title: Data shared with service providers
red.plain_english: Craft shares your personal information with third-party companies that help run the service, like customer support and analytics providers. These providers are bound by their own privacy policies.

red.title: Usage data collected for analytics
red.plain_english: Craft collects information about how you use the app through cookies and third-party analytics providers. This includes data like when you visit shared documents.

red.title: Policy can change without clear notice
red.plain_english: Craft can change its privacy policy at any time and only asks you to check back from time to time. They do not guarantee you will get a direct alert before changes apply.

green.title: No ads or data selling
green.plain_english: Craft explicitly promises it does not sell your data to others or use it for advertising. This is a strong privacy commitment.

green.title: Users can request data deletion
green.plain_english: You can contact Craft to request deletion of your personal information. When you disconnect third-party integrations, cached data is removed promptly.

green.title: Third-party integrations are fully optional
green.plain_english: You can connect or disconnect third-party services like Google Calendar at any time from your account settings. Disconnecting stops Craft from accessing that data.

green.title: Google user data protected
green.plain_english: Craft explicitly states your Google user data is never used for advertising, never shared with data brokers, and never transferred to third parties for purposes unrelated to providing the service.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Craft accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: No camera or microphone access mentioned in the reviewed privacy policy. As a document editor, these permissions may not be required.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Craft collects your location or GPS data.
categories.detail: No location or GPS access mentioned in the reviewed privacy policy.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Craft does not access or collect your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No contacts or phonebook access mentioned in the reviewed privacy policy. The app does not appear to use contact syncing.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Craft accesses your documents and notes when you create or edit them in the app. This is the main purpose of the service.
categories.detail: As a document editor, Craft stores and processes the notes and documents you create. The policy states Craft does not own your data and will not access private notes without consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: Craft does not own your data, nor do we sell it to others or use it for advertising. We will never read or access your private notes without written or verbal consent.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Craft shares your data with trusted third-party companies that help provide the service, like customer support and analytics providers. They explicitly say they do not sell your data.
categories.detail: Personal information is shared with third-party service providers for service provision, information, and products requested. Google user data is explicitly protected and not sold or transferred to third parties for unrelated purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may share any personal information we collect about you with our third-party service providers. We do not sell, transfer, or disclose your Google user data to third parties, except as necessary to provide the Services.
concerns: Data displayed to other users in shared Spaces

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Craft collects your name, email address, and an optional profile photo when you create an account. This information is also displayed to other users when you collaborate in shared Spaces.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name and email address. Optional profile photo may be collected. Email and photo may be displayed to other users in shared Spaces.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account or otherwise use the Services, we collect information such as your name, email address, and an optional profile photo.
concerns: Profile info visible to collaborators in shared Spaces

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Craft explicitly states it does not use your data for advertising. Analytics are used only for product improvement, not for tracking you across apps or showing ads.
categories.detail: No advertising or behavioral tracking. Third-party analytics providers collect usage data for service improvement only. Google user data is never used for advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Craft does not own your data, nor do we sell it to others or use it for advertising. Google user data is never used for advertising, shared with data brokers, or transferred to any third party for purposes unrelated to providing the Services.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Craft says the service is not for children under 16, and they do not knowingly collect data from children. There is no specific age verification mechanism.
categories.detail: Services not directed to children under 16. No knowingly collection of children's personal information. If discovered, data is deleted and account terminated.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Services are not directed to children under 16 (or other age as required by local law), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Craft logs how you access and use the service, including internet activity and cookie data, to keep the service running and improve it.
categories.detail: Usage data and internet/electronic network information collected automatically via cookies and similar technologies. Used for operation, performance, and functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and log Internet or other electronic network information on how you and others access and use Craft, for example, the act of visiting a shared document.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Craft uses third-party providers to collect analytics about how you use the app. This likely includes basic device information like your device type and app version.
categories.detail: Third-party service providers collect and process analytics. Usage data collected automatically. No explicit mention of device fingerprinting, but analytics typically include basic device info.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may also use third-party service providers to collect and process analytics and other information on our Services. These providers are bound by their Privacy Policies to safeguard that information.
concerns: Third-party analytics providers collect device and usage data

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Craft collects health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection mentioned in the reviewed privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Craft processes payments when you subscribe to paid features. The policy mentions payment processing but does not specify whether a third-party processor handles your card details.
categories.detail: Payment information collected for purchase orders and servicing. Third-party service providers may handle payment processing, though not explicitly stated.
categories.policy_excerpt: Processing your payments and otherwise servicing your purchase orders.
concerns: Payment data shared with unspecified service providers

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request Craft to delete or correct your personal information by contacting support. However, some data may be kept as long as necessary to provide the service or comply with laws.
categories.detail: Users can request correction or deletion of personal information. Data retained as long as you use the Services or as necessary to fulfill purposes, provide Services, and comply with laws. Third-party integration data removed promptly upon disconnection.
categories.policy_excerpt: Request Correction of your personal information where it is inaccurate or incomplete. Request Deletion of your personal information. We store the personal information we receive as described in this Privacy Policy for as long as you use our Services or as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected, provide our Services, and comply with applicable laws.
concerns: Some data retained for legal obligations

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Craft can change its privacy policy at any time and asks you to check back occasionally. They do not promise to notify you directly of changes.
categories.detail: Policy may be amended as new features, technology, or legal requirements arise. Users asked to check back from time to time. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: Although significant changes are rare, this policy may be amended as new features, technology, or legal requirements arise, so please check back from time to time. By using the Service, you acknowledge, accept and agree with all provisions of the Privacy Policy.
